title: SLO–OKR Heartbeat: cycle-synced initiative tracker with automated remediation proposals and cross-team handoff
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Reliability initiatives currently live in multiple trackers (sheets, Linear, dashboards). Teams lack a lightweight, cycle-aligned view that ties SLO health (SLIs/error budget runway) directly to OKR initiatives, recommended remediations, and clear handoffs for execution. This causes delayed responses to SLI drift and inconsistent prioritization during sprint/cycle planning.

Goal: Build an 'SLO–OKR Heartbeat' initiative tracker that runs per-cycle (weekly heartbeat), surfaces at-risk SLIs against OKR/initiative priorities, generates a ranked set of remediation proposals (canary rollback, traffic throttles, autoscale tweaks, targeted bugfixes), and produces a recommended cross-team handoff packet (owner, impact, playbook link) to accelerate corrective action. The tracker should fit into PM planning workflows and feed the Console reliability dashboard and on-call playbooks.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Weekly heartbeat view available in Console that lists active initiatives with SLI status, error-budget runway (hrs/days), and OKR alignment tag.
2) Automated remediation proposals appear for initiatives with error-budget runway < 72 hours, including a short justification and risk/cost estimate.
3) Each remediation has a suggested owner and a generated handoff packet (links to relevant runbooks/PRs/dashboards).
4) Integration tests: sampler pipeline verifies dataflow from telemetry -> heartbeat logic -> dashboard for two SLIs (latency P95, request success rate).
5) PMs can override automated rankings and record rationale; overrides are audited.
6) Exportable CSV for weekly planning and a Linear quick-create path to open follow-up tickets with populated fields.
tasks:
- Design data model: map SLI -> initiative -> OKR weight and tolerance thresholds.
- Prototype heartbeat algorithm (score = initiative_priority * SLI_risk_factor / error_budget_runway).
- Build remediation ruleset and templated handoff packet generator.
- Console UI: heartbeat panel + per-initiative detail + quick-create Linear button.
- Backend: scheduled job, telemetry queries, and export API.
- Integration tests and e2e validation using test telemetry.
- Documentation: Confluence playbook + runbook templates for remediation types.
- Launch: small pilot with Platform and Payment teams for two cycles, collect feedback.
progress_updates:
2026-03-11: Kickoff meeting with Platform, Console, and Oncall leads. Agreed SLI canonicalization approach (use namespaced metric ids).
2026-03-12: Prototype scoring script (Python) yields reasonable rankings on past 6 weeks of telemetry; shared notebook in Slack (#reliability).
2026-03-13: Design review with Console UX; identified need for single-click Linear ticket creation with prefilled labels and estimates.
2026-03-14: Backend contract drafted; ENG requested clearer rate-limiting expectations for scheduled queries. Assigned ENG-8421 to address query optimization.
review_feedback:
- Security: ensure remediation packet doesn't leak sensitive runbook links for private deployments (ACTION: redact or gate links based on tenant).
- Oncall: prefer automated proposals to include roll-back windows and suggested monitoring queries.
- Product: require an 'OKR alignment' soft-score so PMs can deprioritize operational work during feature-critical sprints.
Decisions: 1) Build with toggleable tenant-scoped link sharing. 2) Ship scoring in alpha with opt-in pilot teams before org-wide rollout.
metrics:
- Primary: mean time from heartbeat alert to Linear ticket creation (target < 4 hours in pilot).
- Secondary: reduction in error budget burn after remediation within 72 hours (target 30% improvement for pilot teams).
- Adoption: percent of initiatives with OKR alignment tagged (target 80% for pilot).
- Accuracy: percent of automated remediation proposals accepted by owners (target 60% in pilot).
risks:
- False positives: noisy remediations may erode trust. Mitigation: conservative thresholds, pilot, and override auditing.
- Telemetry gaps across Dedicated/Private -> may misrepresent runway. Mitigation: require telemetry health checks in heartbeat preflight.
- Cross-team ownership friction: automated handoffs may be ignored. Mitigation: include human reviewer step and explicit PM opt-in for handoffs.
- Cost: increased query load on telemetry cluster. Mitigation: sampling and caching layer, cost estimate included in remediation packet.
decision_log:
